nonBlockingIssues.description: Unused SyncContext variable constructed in processOperation() but never passed to hooks or handlers. Should be removed or documented.
onError-converted failure results still get syncStatus:'synced' enrichment. Consistent with existing behavior but worth noting.
WeakMap idempotency tracking relies on handler instance identity within a single operation. Works in practice but is subtle.
LibHandlerRegistry.clear() called in SyncService constructor is a static method. Could affect other instances in tests.
db client cast as any when passing to SyncEngineConfig. Should remove cast and fix type mismatches properly.
Library uses mergeDefined() instead of object spread in a couple of places. Semantically equivalent but subtle difference.
mapFields passthrough branch for empty mapping is an improvement but changes behavior slightly. Not documented.
ConflictResolverAdapter uses 'as unknown as' cast instead of explicitly implementing IGenericConflictResolver.
Backend maintains its own NoOpConflictResolver identical to library version. Could deduplicate in future cleanup.
GenericSyncHandler.ts, SyncHandlerBuilder.ts, and types.ts still exist in backend handlers/core/ as dead code with no imports.
SyncEngineDeps interface is duplicated between backend types.ts and library. Tight coupling via 14 repository imports.
